violations.text: Sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Sauce was observed between 52-54 DF and was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Various food was observed held between 45 and 50 degrees Fahrenheit in the kitchen prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Prep unit was observed holding an ambient temperature of 49 DF. Food observed at 45 DF or lower was moved to walk-in cooler. Food observed at 46 DF or higher was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in prep unit until unit is able to maintain an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, chicken was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Chicken was put on to sheet pans and placed into the walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed with staff. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The 1 door reach-in and prep unit gaskets were observed in poor repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
Establishment is lacking drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The condensate from the air conditioner was observed draining into the hand-washing sink. Condensate/wastewater must drain into and drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026

The floor/wall to the right of the 3-bay sink, and floor/wall to the right of the grease trap area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the ware washing area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
The condensate from the air conditioner was observed draining into the hand washing sink. Condensate/wastewater must drain into and drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2025

The coving in the front kitchen is in poor repair, observed missing pieces. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2025

Mozzarella and chicken were observed held at 43-45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC moved to walk-in cooler. Foods were put in unit less than 2 hours prior, foods were relocated to walk-in cooler at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025
Establishment is using time as a control for pizza without written approval. PIC informed to cease process until approval is granted from RIDOH CFP. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025
Observed missing hot water knozel on hand wash sink located in the back kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2025
The following units were not in good repair. 1. Pizza prep unit 2. Reach-in refrigerator Ambient of refrigeration units must be at 41F or below. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025

The coving in the front kitchen is in poor repair, observed missing pieces. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025
The ledge next to the ware washing area is in poor repair, observed exposed wood with incomplete seal. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/02/2025

The prep sink is lacking a proper air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/02/2025
The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
The coving in the kitchen area is in poor repair, observed missing tiles. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
The ceiling tile in the ware washing area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/02/2025
